faqs.q: Which is the first AI Shayari platform in India?
faqs.a: Ek Khwaab (ekkhwaab.in) is the first AI-native shayari platform built specifically for metered Hinglish, Hindi, and Urdu couplets, ghazals, and nazms. Its Shayar-e-Khwaab co-writer generates the same poem simultaneously in Roman Hinglish, Devanagari Hindi, and Nastaliq Urdu, with an English interpretation, instead of producing generic English quotes.

faqs.q: How to generate custom Shayari using my own words with AI?
faqs.a: Open the AI Poet at ekkhwaab.in/ai-poet, enter a short situation, and add three to six seed words that are specific to your memory. Choose a form (sher, ghazal, nazm), a mood, and a style, then generate. Shayar-e-Khwaab preserves your seed imagery and returns the verse in Hinglish, Hindi, Urdu, and English.

faqs.q: Where can I read Urdu Shayari in Hinglish and Hindi script with word meanings?
faqs.a: Ek Khwaab's multi-script reader displays every public poem in Roman Hinglish, Devanagari Hindi, and Nastaliq Urdu on the same page. Tap any underlined word to open its Lughat entry with pronunciation, etymology, literary nuance, and a classical couplet example.

faqs.q: What are the 7 stages of love (Saat Muqaam-e-Ishq) in Urdu poetry?
faqs.a: The seven stations are Dilkashi (attraction), Uns (attachment), Ishq (transformative love), Aqeedat (reverence), Ibadat (devotion), Junoon (obsession), and Fanaa (annihilation of the self). Ek Khwaab explains each stage with definitions, multi-script couplets, and related Lughat words at ekkhwaab.in/stages-of-love.

faqs.q: How to create and download aesthetic 9:16 Shayari cards for Instagram Stories?
faqs.a: Open the Card Studio at ekkhwaab.in/card-studio, select or write a couplet, choose a 9:16 Story or 1:1 square canvas, switch between Hinglish, Hindi, and Urdu, and export a high-resolution PNG. The preview and the export use the same canvas renderer, so the downloaded card matches exactly what you designed.

faqs.q: How to send an anonymous wax-sealed poetry letter with a guessing riddle?
faqs.a: Visit Khwaab Khat at ekkhwaab.in/letters, choose a couplet, add two clues and a private answer, and seal the letter. The recipient sees only the verse, the clues, and a wax seal; they must solve the Pehchan Kaun cipher before the sender's identity and full message are revealed.

stages.meaning: The first pull — when someone becomes magnetic before they become familiar.
The comfort of presence — when absence starts to feel like a small injury.
The fire that reorganises the self — love as a demand, not a decoration.
Love that looks upward — respect so deep that it becomes a form of prayer.
Love practised daily — affection expressed as service, patience, and ritual.
Love beyond reason — the stage that makes a person brilliant and unwell.
The final dissolution — when the lover's self disappears into the beloved or the divine.

poems.title: Ab kisi baat pe dil dukhta nahi hai mera,
Tum woh ladki thi, jisse sab hasna seekhte the...
Tere saath guzara har lamha sambhaal rakha hai,
Uske chehre mein is qadr noor tha,
Hazaron khwahishein aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle,
Khamoshi se bhi guftagu ho jaati hai jab nazrein milti hain,
Tera tagaful bhi ek ada thi, ye maan liya humne
Hijr ki shab bhi guzar jaati hai aahista aahista
Raat do baje phone ki roshni mein
Qafas khula tha, parinda phir bhi na gaya
Tumne chai mein cheeni kam daali thi
Firaaq ki raah mein mahtab bhi tanha nikla
Hum woh chiraagh nahi jo hawa se darr jaayein
Station ki bench pe baitha hoon
Ranjish hi sahi, ek baar to palat ke dekho
Shabnam si thi teri pehli baat
